name: nahiri, heir of the ancients
mana cost: {2}{R}{W}
types: legendary planeswalker nahiri
loyalty: 4
planeswalker[1]: [+1]: create a 1/1 white kor warrior creature token. you may attach an equipment you control to it.
planeswalker[2]: [-2]: look at the top six cards of your library. you may reveal a warrior or equipment card from among them and put it into your hand. put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
planeswalker[3]: [-3]: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to twice the number of equipment you control.
replacement: CARDNAME enters with four loyalty counters on it.
